about_the_game:
**Bring an adorable puppy to your desktop!**

"My Desktop Puppy" is a lightweight virtual pet game that brings a lively, interactive dog to your computer screen. Your desktop will never feel lonely again!

Pet it, feed it, drag it around, and watch it roll, sit, sleep, and play. Every puppy has its own personality and animations, just like a real pet who lives with you on your desktop.

### Features:

- 🌟 Real desktop pet experience: The puppy walks, naps, and interacts on top of your desktop

- 🎮 Easy and relaxing controls: click, drag, toss toys and food

- 🍖 Interactive feeding system: drag food from your inventory and the puppy comes running!

- 🎨 Cute pixel-style visuals with 2.5D animations

- 🧸 Multiple toys and items to enrich interactions

- 🖼️ Smooth animations like blinking, lying down, and chasing balls

This little pup will brighten your day while you work, study, or just hang out with your computer.

(Development is still ongoing – more animations, skins, and customization features are on the way. Add to your wishlist and stay tuned!)

name: My Desktop Puppy: 我的桌面小狗
short_description: 一只聪明又可爱的桌面小狗，拥有独立 AI 行为机制，支持多种互动模式。安静陪伴、活泼捣蛋，还能开启“遛狗”模式。控件可自由拖动，不打扰你的工作，有些模式甚至鼓励你专心。 A smart and adorable desktop puppy with its own AI behavior system. Switch between calm, playful, or walk modes. All UI elements are fully draggable and won’t interrupt your workflow—some modes even help you focus.
